question: In February 2025, a self-cleaning, flexible heating fabric was developed by ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Guwahati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **February 2025**, researchers at **IIT Guwahati** developed a revolutionary **self-cleaning, flexible heating fabric**. This innovative fabric combines functionalities of heating and self-cleaning, making it a significant advancement in the textile and wearable technology industries.
 
• The fabric was engineered using advanced **nanotechnology** and materials science. The primary aim was to create a material capable of maintaining hygiene while also providing heating capabilities, especially for use in extreme cold weather conditions.
 
• The self-cleaning feature is achieved through the application of **hydrophobic coatings** or nanomaterials, which repel water and dirt particles, ensuring that the fabric remains clean without requiring frequent washing. *Hence, the development aligns with sustainability goals.*
 
• The heating property is integrated into the fabric using **conductive materials** such as graphene or carbon-based composites. These materials allow the fabric to generate heat when an electric current is passed through it.
 
• The product is expected to have applications in **wearable technology**, **healthcare**, and **extreme climate survival**. These features make it an ideal choice for outdoor workers, defense personnel, or individuals living in cold regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati:**

 
 
• **Location:** Situated in Guwahati, Assam, IIT Guwahati is one of India’s premier institutions for research and innovation.
 
• **Specialization:** Known for its cutting-edge research in **nanotechnology**, **materials science**, and **engineering**.
 
• **Recognition:** It is recognized globally for its contributions to **technology development** and **sustainable solutions**.
 
 
 
• **Characteristics of the Self-Cleaning and Heating Fabric:**
 
 
• **Self-Cleaning Property:** The fabric is coated with nanomaterials that repel **water**, **oil**, and **dust particles**.
 
• **Heating Capability:** Conductive materials like **graphene** allow the fabric to generate heat when powered by a small electric current.
 
• **Durability:** Designed to withstand extreme weather conditions and prolonged usage.
 
• **Applications:** Suitable for **military uniforms**, **outdoor sportswear**, and **medical textiles**.
 
 
 
• **Comparative Analysis of IITs:**
 
 
• **IIT Madras:** Known for its excellence in **data science**, **AI**, and **robotics**.
 
• **IIT Delhi:** Specializes in **electronics**, **telecommunication**, and **entrepreneurship development**.
 
• **IIT Bombay:** Renowned for **mechanical engineering**, **automobile engineering**, and **design innovation**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sustainability Goals:**

 
 
• The development of self-cleaning fabric aligns with global efforts to reduce **water wastage** in washing and promote **eco-friendly textiles**.
 
• The heating fabric is energy-efficient, providing maximum utility with minimal power consumption.
 
 
 
• **Future Prospects:**
 
 
• Potential for commercialization in industries like **defense**, **sports**, and **healthcare**.
 
• Scope for further research in integrating **smart sensors** for health monitoring and environmental adaptation.
